detail.ask: Which single next move would make the loop compound on this corpus: rank the candidates, choose one and a runner-up, and develop both to implementation depth with the experiment that would test the choice and the first mathematical result it should produce.

Two tracks: the invention that would make the residualiser produce new kernel-proved suppliers that shrink residuals across demands, and the strongest attack on the #249 good-base first-harmonic gap; rank the candidates in each and develop the choice and a runner-up.

Three questions: prove the one remaining #249 estimate in the weakest form the corpus accepts; design to code level the machine that would have found round 3's endpoint route by itself across all eight problems, with its acceptance experiment; and the highest-leverage change nobody had asked for.

Five questions: the next capability of the machine that computes each open problem's frontier, designed to code level; how restatements re-enter the library without double counting; the evaluation that would convince a sceptical reviewer; what the systems paper needs; and a wildcard.

Four questions, all about infrastructure: what it is and what it should become, to code level; what to build from the corpus's many restatements and conditional reductions; what would make the systems paper definitive; and a wildcard.
